Show a warning banner on the Quotation form when the discount exceeds 20%
Customize the list view of Customers so that inactive ones show a red indicator
Create a Workspace with shortcuts to the five DocTypes our team uses every day

evals.prompt: Add a client-side script to the Sales Order form that, when a custom field `expected_delivery_days` is filled, automatically sets `delivery_date` to today plus that many days.
evals.expected_output: A Form Script (or Client Script) using frappe.ui.form.on with the correct event and field APIs
expectations: Uses `frappe.ui.form.on('Sales Order', { expected_delivery_days: function(frm) { ... } })` or equivalent
Computes the date with `frappe.datetime.add_days(frappe.datetime.get_today(), days)` or similar Frappe date utility
Does not use raw `new Date()` arithmetic when a Frappe date utility covers the case
Notes that the script lives in a Client Script record (Desk > Customization > Client Script), not in app Python code

evals.prompt: I want the Customer list view to show a red dot for customers whose `credit_limit` is 0 and a green dot otherwise. How do I configure this without touching Python code?
evals.expected_output: Instructions for setting up a List View indicator using the Frappe indicator map convention
expectations: Uses the `frappe.listview_settings` object in a List View Script or Client Script scoped to Customer list
Sets `listview_settings.get_indicator` as a function returning `['Red', ...]` or `['Green', ...]` based on `credit_limit`
Does not require a Python file change; the indicator logic lives in a client-side customization
Notes that the indicator label and color must use Frappe's supported color names
